scheme.name: add
scheme.description: Sum the data point and correction value. E.g. y=x+C, where x is the data point and C is the change factor.

scheme.name: lw_corr
scheme.description: Correction for long wave radiation where calibration values are incorrect.

scheme.name: scalar
scheme.description: Multiply the data point by a correction factor. E.g. y=Cx where x is the data point and C is the correction factor.

scheme.name: pa_corr
scheme.description: Correct air pressure with bias calculated from mean sea level pressure.

scheme.name: power
scheme.description: Raise data point to power of correction factor. E.g. y=x^C where x is the data point and C is the correction factor.

scheme.name: wd
scheme.description: Correct wind direction where wind sensor installed backwards.

scheme.name: clip
scheme.description: Clip values above or below threshold to the threshold.

scheme.name: albedo_south_slope_correction
scheme.description: Correct albedo based on slope of station.

scheme.name: range
scheme.description: Data fell outside of legitimate min and max.

scheme.name: battery_v
scheme.description: The battery voltage was too low to power the sensor properly.

scheme.name: samples
scheme.description: Too few samples were taken by the logger from the sensor within the measuring period.

scheme.name: error_code
scheme.description: The data value is an error code.

scheme.name: spike
scheme.description: Spike in the data detected.

scheme.name: nr01_temp
scheme.description: The NR01 sensor temperature was out of operating range, meaning data cannot be trusted.

scheme.name: hfp_removal
scheme.description: Data removed during heat flux plate calibration period.

scheme.name: pluvio_diag
scheme.description: Pluvio rainguage sent error diagnostic.

scheme.name: snowd_signal
scheme.description: Signal from snow depth sensor too low.

scheme.name: tdt_tsoil
scheme.description: Soil temperature too low for TDT to operate correctly.

scheme.name: linear_interp
scheme.description: Linear interpolation used to infill gap.

scheme.name: alt_data
scheme.description: Alternative data used to infill gap.
